subject.title: feat(config): add compaction.thinkingLevel to override thinking level during compaction

question: Should OpenClaw expose and support an embedded-only `agents.defaults.compaction.thinkingLevel` override even though native Codex app-server compaction cannot apply it?
rationale: The patch is internally coherent and prior review found no mechanical blocker, but adding a persistent public config/SDK surface and a deliberate runtime asymmetry is a product-contract choice rather than an implementation correction.

options.title: Adopt the embedded-only override
options.body: Accept the additive configuration and its documented native-Codex warning behavior as a supported public contract.

options.title: Keep a single inherited thinking behavior
options.body: Decline the new setting and preserve session-level inheritance as the only compaction thinking policy.

recommendation.title: Adopt the embedded-only override
recommendation.body: Accept the additive configuration and its documented native-Codex warning behavior as a supported public contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The current branch history shows direct ownership of the integration and public SDK-surface reconciliation.
